now.title: Spider-Man (1994)#37
now.text: War Machine helps Spider-Man fight Venom and Carnage at Stark Enterprises. He keeps Jameson from unmasking the fallen Spider-Man, but is too badly hurt to fight on.
now.on_b_card_about_a: A hero War Machine fights beside.

proposed.text: War Machine helps Spider-Man fight Venom and Carnage at Stark Enterprises, until Carnage beats them both.

split.title: Spider-Man (1994)#38
split.text: After Venom and Carnage flee, the hurt War Machine stops Jameson from unmasking the fallen Spider-Man.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Helps Peter fight Venom, then keeps Jameson from unmasking him.
split.on_b_card_about_a: A hero War Machine fights beside and protects.

changes.evidence: Episode 37 (Venom Returns) ends with Carnage defeating Spider-Man and War Machine. Jameson trying to unmask the injured Spider-Man and being stopped by the hurt War Machine opens episode 38 (Carnage), per the Marvel Database synopsis of Season 3 ep 11.

now.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man#4
now.text: Dmitri is part of Mila's robbery crew. When the police close in, Mila escapes with the money and Dmitri is caught.
now.on_a_card_about_b: A member of Mila's crew. She breaks him out.

changes.evidence: In #4 (Hitting the Big Time) Mila escapes with the money and Dmitri is arrested; she breaks him out of prison only in #5 (The Unicorn Unleashed!). The #4 card line tells the #5 breakout.

now.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man#5
now.text: The Unicorn uses Mikhail as bait, but after Spider-Man saves him, Mikhail takes her helmet and the police arrest them both.

proposed.text: Mila uses her new helmet to break Mikhail and the rest of the crew out of prison.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Mikhail's partner. Breaks him out of prison.

changes.evidence: In #5 the order is: Mila breaks the crew out of prison first, then during the fight she uses Mikhail as bait, he pulls off her helmet and both are arrested. The two #5 stages are in reverse order, so the pair ends #5 as allies when the episode leaves them at odds. Swap stages 1 and 2 (this is stage 1).

now.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man#5
now.text: Mila uses her new helmet to break Mikhail and the rest of the crew out of prison.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Mikhail's partner. Breaks him out of prison.

proposed.text: The Unicorn uses Mikhail as bait, but after Spider-Man saves him, Mikhail takes her helmet and the police arrest them both.

changes.evidence: Second half of the swap: the bait fight and Mikhail taking her helmet come after the breakout in #5 and end the episode with both arrested.

now.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man#4
now.text: Dmitri is one of the robbers Spider-Man chases, and the police catch him while Spider-Man saves people from the blaze.

changes.evidence: Mila first takes the name the Unicorn in #5 (The Unicorn Unleashed!); in #4 she is only Mila Masaryk of the Russian crew, so the #4 card line uses a later name.

now.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man#4
now.text: Mikhail is part of the Russian robbery crew Spider-Man chases, and the police catch him.

changes.evidence: Mila first calls herself the Unicorn in #5 (The Unicorn Unleashed!); at #4 the name is a later one.

now.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man#8
now.text: Together Carla and Peter get the Magnetic Generator working.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Peter's supervisor at Oscorp, who believes in him.

proposed.text: While Peter is away, Carla and the interns test his Magnetic Generator successfully. When he turns up hurt, Carla worries and urges him to go home.

changes.evidence: In #8 (Tangled Web) the interns celebrate a successful test of Peter's Magnetic Generator that he missed; he apologizes to Carla for missing the demonstration, and she worries about his injuries and urges him to go home. They do not get it working together.

now.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man
now.text: Doctor Strange fights an alien at Midtown High on Peter's first day, and a spider from his portal bites Peter. Later Peter helps Strange send the alien back and close Norman's gateway, and the two become friends.
now.on_a_card_about_b: The sorcerer Peter helps close Norman's gateway.

proposed.text: Doctor Strange fights an alien at Midtown High on Peter's first day, and a spider that comes through his portal bites Peter.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: The sorcerer whose portal brings the spider that bites Peter.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A freshman bitten by a spider from Strange's portal.

split.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man#10
split.text: When Norman's gateway lets the alien through, Peter helps Strange send it back to space and destroy the gateway.
split.on_a_card_about_b: The sorcerer Peter helps close Norman's gateway.
split.on_b_card_about_a: A young hero who helps Strange close Norman's gateway.

changes.evidence: The stage starts at #1 but tells the gateway fight, which is #10 (If This Be My Destiny...): Strange and Peter send the alien back to space and destroy the gateway. In #1 only Strange's fight at Midtown and the spider bite happen.

now.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man
now.text: Spider-Man saves Harry from thugs, and Harry learns Peter's secret and guides him from Oscorp. He has a new red and blue suit made for Peter, and they stay friends after Peter cuts ties with Oscorp.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Peter's friend and guide at Oscorp.
now.on_b_card_about_a: The friend Harry backs as Spider-Man.

proposed.text: Spider-Man saves Harry from a group of thugs on his way to school.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The masked hero who saves Harry from thugs.

split.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man#4
split.text: At Oscorp, Peter accidentally reveals to Harry that he is Spider-Man.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Norman's son, who learns Peter's secret.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Secretly Spider-Man, as Harry finds out.

split.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man#5
split.text: Norman brings Harry into the Spider-Man partnership, and Harry guides Peter from Oscorp.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Peter's friend and guide at Oscorp.
split.on_b_card_about_a: The friend Harry backs as Spider-Man.

split.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man#8
split.text: Harry has Oscorp's engineers make Peter a new red and blue Spider-Man suit.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Peter's friend and guide at Oscorp.
split.on_b_card_about_a: The friend Harry backs as Spider-Man.

split.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man#10
split.text: Peter quits Oscorp and cannot trust Norman again, but he and Harry stay friends.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Peter's friend, still on his side after Oscorp.
split.on_b_card_about_a: The friend Harry backs as Spider-Man.

changes.evidence: The stage starts at #1 but tells events from later episodes: #1 Spider-Man saves Harry from thugs; #4 Peter accidentally reveals his identity to Harry; #5 Norman involves Harry in the Spider-Man partnership; #8 Harry reveals the new red and blue suit; #10 Peter quits the internship while Harry stays with him.
